facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The ZC31S established the modern Swift Sport as an engaging junior hot hatch. Contemporary driving praised its eager naturally aspirated engine, responsive chassis and accessible B-road enjoyment, giving this generation a lasting sporting identity beyond the ordinary Swift range.

cars.generation: ZC32S second modern global Swift Sport production-road generation
cars.variant: M16A six-speed manual — 2011 Japan production-road reference
cars.specification_market: Read the 2011 ZC32S archive section and six-speed-manual column, not CVT. Final Japanese production announcement confirms 100 kW, superseding the August show release’s provisional status. No CVT equipment or unverified mass basis is imported; intake/exhaust VVT scope is not inferred from the abbreviated heritage table. One full model generation is counted.
cars.summary: The ZC32S carried the lightweight, naturally aspirated hot-hatch recipe into a new Swift generation with a six-speed manual and revised chassis. Contemporary driving valued its agility and high-rev engagement as a modern expression of the classic small hot hatch, rather than judging it only by headline power.

cars.generation: ZC33S third modern global Swift Sport production-road generation
cars.variant: Original K14C six-speed manual — 2017 Japan heritage reference
cars.specification_market: Read the original 2017 Japanese K14C/ZC33S archive section and six-speed-manual column, not six-speed automatic or later K14D mild hybrid. Preserve the Japanese archive’s native 1371 cc; no other-market displacement is silently substituted. Exact mass basis, torque-peak range, foreign safety-equipment fitment and performance claims are withheld. One ZC33S generation is counted.
cars.summary: The ZC33S continued Swift Sport’s established entry-level performance lineage with a lighter body and a responsive turbocharged engine. First-hand driving found an accessible, enjoyable quick car, while acknowledging reduced adjustability; this is a substantive new-generation hot hatch, not a cosmetic edition of its predecessor.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The ZC33S continued Swift Sport’s established entry-level performance lineage with a lighter body and a responsive turbocharged engine. First-hand driving found an accessible, enjoyable quick car, while acknowledging reduced adjustability; this is a substantive new-generation hot hatch, not a cosmetic edition of its predecessor.
